body: What is a cover letter? A cover letter is an introduction to you and a crucial way to identify yourself and differentiate yourself from all other resume applications.

Your cover letter highlights should consist of your most notable qualifications, credentials, experiences, skills, and achievements solely related to the position in which you are applying. State clearly how you will benefit the company. Keep it relative to the job position application.

Keep your cover letter to one page only and keep it relevant, with all of your most important information towards the top — there are many applicants, and most cover letters go unread if too long. Your cover letter must be specifically appealing to the company's needs and interests.

Analyze the job listing. Find the most important aspects they're looking for that match with your own skillset. Use these in your resume and cover letter. Emphasize why you are the most suitable person for the job, and aim to convince the employer to interview you.
Thank the reader and employer for their consideration of this position and potential interview. State that you are looking forward to the next step of the job application.
